q: Why is creamy cropmen exceeding expectations again. Drops adds, or just players playing well?
short: Both, but mostly volume of adds: Ben F. has made 20 of the league's 94 transactions, and nearly every non-star on his roster is a pickup scoring above projection.
answer:
Creamy Cropmen (Ben F., 2-1) has scored 4,791 points, second in the league behind Angel Reese at 5,352, yet our power rating has him 9th of 10 (388.6) and his core rating of 373.5 is near the bottom. That gap is what looks like exceeding expectations.

Two things drive it. First, the stars are legit: Luka Doncic is averaging 69.0 FP per game against a 60.6 projection, and Franz Wagner is at 42.6 against 38.6. Those two account for about 248 of his 1,479 projected points this week.

Second, he is the most active manager in the league by far. He has 20 transactions out of 94 total (next is Angel Reese's team with 14), almost all free agent pickups, and 11 of his 17 rostered players are players he added. Many are beating projection: Davion Mitchell 41.3 vs 25.5 projected, Wendell Carter Jr. 34.6 vs 23.0, Jalen Smith 31.4 vs 22.4, Aaron Wiggins 28.2 vs 19.2, Kyshawn George 35.4 vs 30.2. Some of that is real role gains, some is a hot start that projections lag behind, so expect some regression. Caveat: those season averages include games before he picked them up, so I can't cleanly split points earned under his ownership.

His latest pickup, Brook Lopez on Nov 10 for Naji Marshall, shows the pattern: he churns the back end of the roster toward whoever has a role right now. Tyrese Haliburton and Kawhi Leonard sit on IR scoring nothing, so the depth is carrying him.

Bottom line: not luck alone and not drops alone. It is star production plus constant streaming of the free agent pool. His projection this week (1,479) is mid-pack, so I would treat him as a decent but not elite team. The same free agent pool is open to you.

moves.do: Check the free agent list daily for players with fresh minutes, as Creamy Cropmen does
moves.why: He has made 20 moves vs your 12, and his 11 pickups average about 31 FP per game.
